Apne Parwardigar ke naam ki tasbeeh karo jis ki shaan sab se unchi hai.
Jis ne sab kuchh paida kiya aur theek theek banaya.
Aur jis ne har cheez ko ek khaas andaz diya, phir raasta bataya.
Aur jis ne sabz chara (zameen se) nikala.
Phir use kale rang ka kora banadiya.
(ae payghumbar) hum tumhein parhaein ge phir tum bhoolo ge nahin.
Siwaye us ke jise Allah chahaye. Yaqeen rakho woh khuli hui cheezon ko bhi jaanta hai aur un cheezon ko bhi jo chhpi hui hain.
Aur hum tumhein aasan shariyat (par chalne ke liye) sahulat den ge.
Lihaza tum naseehat kiye jao, agar naseehat ka faida ho.
Jis ke dil mein Allah ka khof hoga, woh naseehat maane ga.
Aur us se door woh rahe ga jo bara badbakht hoga.
Jo sab se bari aag mein dakhil hoga.
Phir us aag mein na mare ga aur na jiye ga.
Falaah us ne payi hai jis ne pakeezgi ikhtiyar ki.
Aur apne Parwardigar ka naam liya, aur namaz parhi.
Lekin tum log dunyawi zindagi ko muqaddam rakhte ho.
Halaanke aakhirat kahin ziyada behtar aur kahin ziyada payedaar hai.
Yeh baat yaqeenan pichle (aasmani) saheefon mein bhi darj hai.
Ibrahim aur musa ke saheefon mein.
